label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use Engaging Visuals
body: Pictures and GIFs can make your emails more interesting and help explain your message faster.
caption:
Emails full of just text can sometimes feel a bit heavy. Break it up with a relevant photo of your work, a helpful infographic, or even a simple GIF to add some personality. Visuals grab attention, explain complex ideas quickly, and make your emails more enjoyable to read. Just make sure they load fast and look good on any device. What's your favorite way to add visuals to your emails? 🤔
